info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v2-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Validation API allows users to verify the authenticity and validity of event tickets in real-time. This endpoint is essential for event organizers and ticketing services to ensure that only valid tickets are accepted, preventing fraud and ensuring a seamless entry experience for attendees. Users can submit ticket information and receive immediate validation results. Typical consumers include ticketing platforms, event venues, and organizers who require efficient ticket management and fraud prevention solutions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to validate a ticket against the system to ensure its authenticity and status. It checks the ticket details and returns whether the ticket is valid or invalid.

requestBody.description: Request payload used to validate ticket information. This body must adhere to the specified schema to ensure successful validation.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the ticket validation is confirmed.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.description: A JSON string representing the request body for validating ticket operations.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.title: Ticket Validation Response

status.description: Indicates if the ticket validation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the validation request.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the validation operation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after validation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the validation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the validation outcome.

audit.description: Information related to the auditing of the validation request.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.description: Schema representing the response structure for the ticket validation operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the audit record.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the audit record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically or manually.

AuditInfo.description: Schema representing the auditing information for a request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the request was processed instantly.
